examples.en: Confucius was a famous teacher in ancient China.
examples.zh: 孔子是中國古代一位著名的老師。

examples.en: We learned about Confucius in our history class.
examples.zh: 我們在歷史課上學習了與孔子有關的知識。

examples.en: Many people in Taiwan visit the temple of Confucius every year.
examples.zh: 每年都有許多台灣人參訪孔廟。

examples.en: My dad cooks dinner for us every Sunday.
examples.zh: 我爸爸每個星期天都會煮晚餐給我們吃。

examples.en: Dad, can you drive me to school this morning?
examples.zh: 爸，你今天早上可以載我去學校嗎？

examples.en: She asked her dad to help her fix the bicycle.
examples.zh: 她請爸爸幫她修理腳踏車。

examples.en: England is famous for its rainy weather and old castles.
examples.zh: 英格蘭以多雨的天氣和古老的城堡聞名。

examples.en: My cousin is studying business in England.
examples.zh: 我的表哥正在英格蘭念商學。

examples.en: We will fly to England for our summer trip.
examples.zh: 我們暑假旅行要搭飛機去英格蘭。

examples.en: Europe has many countries that are close to each other.
examples.zh: 歐洲有許多彼此距離相近的國家。

examples.en: They traveled around Europe by train last summer.
examples.zh: 他們去年夏天搭火車在歐洲各地旅行。

examples.en: Her aunt has lived in Europe for over ten years.
examples.zh: 她的阿姨已經在歐洲住了十多年。

examples.en: She enjoys European history and art and often visits museums.
examples.zh: 她喜歡歐洲的歷史與藝術，經常參觀博物館。

examples.en: This restaurant serves traditional European food made with fresh local ingredients.
examples.zh: 這家餐廳供應以新鮮當地食材製作的傳統歐洲料理。

examples.en: The European team won the match easily.
examples.zh: 歐洲隊輕鬆贏得了比賽。

examples.en: A European sat next to me on the plane.
examples.zh: 有一位歐洲人坐在我旁邊的飛機座位上。

examples.en: Many Europeans enjoy riding bicycles to work.
examples.zh: 許多歐洲人喜歡騎腳踏車上班。

examples.en: The tour guide is a friendly European.
examples.zh: 這位導遊是個親切的歐洲人。

examples.en: Everybody in our class passed the English test.
examples.zh: 我們班上每個人都通過了英文考試。

examples.en: Is everybody ready to leave for the museum?
examples.zh: 大家都準備好要出發去博物館了嗎？

examples.en: Everybody likes the new teacher because she is so kind.
examples.zh: 大家都喜歡這位新老師，因為她很親切。

examples.en: France is well known for its bread and cheese.
examples.zh: 法國以麵包和起司聞名。

examples.en: We plan to visit France during the winter vacation.
examples.zh: 我們打算在寒假去法國玩。

examples.en: My teacher was born in France but works in Taipei.
examples.zh: 我的老師出生在法國，但在台北工作。

examples.en: Germany is known for making cars sold around the world.
examples.zh: 德國以製造銷往世界各地的汽車聞名。

examples.en: My brother is studying engineering in Germany.
examples.zh: 我哥哥正在德國念工程。

examples.en: We flew from Taipei to Germany last month.
examples.zh: 我們上個月從台北搭機前往德國。

examples.en: He is a good-looking boy with a warm smile.
examples.zh: 他是個長得好看的男孩，笑容很溫暖。

examples.en: The actress is very good-looking and kind to fans.
examples.zh: 這位女演員非常漂亮，而且對粉絲很親切。

examples.en: They bought a good-looking sofa for the living room.
examples.zh: 他們為客廳買了一張好看的沙發。

examples.en: I saw her at the library yesterday afternoon.
examples.zh: 我昨天下午在圖書館看到她。

examples.en: Please give her the keys before you leave.
examples.zh: 離開前請把鑰匙交給她。

examples.en: The teacher asked her to read the story aloud.
examples.zh: 老師請她把故事朗讀出來。

examples.en: Her bag is under the desk next to the window.
examples.zh: 她的書包在窗邊的書桌底下。

examples.en: Mina forgot her umbrella on the bus.
examples.zh: 米娜把雨傘忘在公車上了。

examples.en: Her new teacher is very friendly and answers questions patiently.
examples.zh: 她的新老師非常友善，會耐心回答問題。

examples.en: The heroine in the movie saves her village.
examples.zh: 電影裡的女主角拯救了她的村莊。

examples.en: Many children see the nurse as a heroine.
examples.zh: 許多孩子把那位護理師視為女英雄。

examples.en: The heroine of the novel is a brave young girl.
examples.zh: 這本小說的女主角是個勇敢的年輕女孩。

examples.en: Mary bought herself a new notebook for her science class.
examples.zh: 瑪莉為了上自然課，幫自己買了一本新筆記本。

examples.en: She made the cake by herself for her mother's birthday.
examples.zh: 這個蛋糕是她為媽媽生日獨自做的。

examples.en: The girl looked at herself in the mirror.
examples.zh: 女孩看著鏡子裡的自己。

examples.en: Please tell him to call me back.
examples.zh: 請告訴他回電話給我。

examples.en: We gave him a gift for his birthday.
examples.zh: 我們送了他一份生日禮物。

examples.en: I met him at the station this morning.
examples.zh: 我今天早上在車站遇到他。

examples.en: Tom taught himself how to play the guitar.
examples.zh: 湯姆自己學會了彈吉他。

examples.en: He cut himself while cooking dinner and put on a bandage.
examples.zh: 他煮晚餐時割傷了自己，並用繃帶包紮。

examples.en: The boy dressed himself for school without any help from his parents.
examples.zh: 這個男孩沒讓父母幫忙，自己穿好衣服去上學。

senses.zh: 女主人；女接待員；女主持人

examples.en: The hostess welcomed every guest at the door.
examples.zh: 女主人在門口歡迎每一位客人。

examples.en: A hostess led us to a table by the window.
examples.zh: 一位女接待員帶我們到靠窗的座位。

examples.en: The hostess of the show asked the guests a few questions.
examples.zh: 節目的女主持人問了來賓幾個問題。

examples.en: Hualien is famous for its beautiful mountains and coast.
examples.zh: 花蓮以美麗的山脈和海岸聞名。

examples.en: We took a train to Hualien during the long weekend.
examples.zh: 我們利用連假搭火車去了花蓮。

examples.en: My grandparents live in a small town near Hualien.
examples.zh: 我的祖父母住在花蓮附近的小鎮。

examples.en: The dog wagged its tail when I came home.
examples.zh: 我回到家時，小狗搖了搖牠的尾巴。

examples.en: This phone is nice, but its battery is weak.
examples.zh: 這支手機不錯，但它的電池不耐用。

examples.en: The company changed its name last year.
examples.zh: 那家公司去年更改了它的名稱。

examples.en: The cat cleaned itself with its tongue.
examples.zh: 貓用舌頭把自己舔乾淨。

examples.en: The door closed by itself when a strong wind blew.
examples.zh: 一陣強風吹來時，門自己關上了。

examples.en: The museum itself is more interesting than the gift shop.
examples.zh: 博物館本身比禮品店有趣多了。

examples.en: Japan is only a few hours away from Taiwan by plane.
examples.zh: 從台灣搭飛機到日本只要幾個小時。

examples.en: We ate delicious sushi when we visited Japan.
examples.zh: 我們去日本時吃了很好吃的壽司。

examples.en: Her family moved to Japan for her father's job.
examples.zh: 她的家人因為爸爸的工作搬到了日本。

examples.en: I bought a Japanese dictionary at the bookstore.
examples.zh: 我在書店買了一本日語字典。

examples.en: They had a Japanese breakfast at the hotel.
examples.zh: 他們在飯店吃了日式早餐。

examples.en: She is learning Japanese music at school.
examples.zh: 她在學校學習日本音樂。

examples.en: My cousin can speak Japanese very well.
examples.zh: 我的表姊日語說得很好。

examples.en: The Japanese in our tour group were very polite.
examples.zh: 我們旅行團裡的日本人都很有禮貌。

examples.en: Japanese is not easy, but I like it.
examples.zh: 日語不容易，但我很喜歡。

examples.en: Kaohsiung is a big port city in southern Taiwan.
examples.zh: 高雄是台灣南部的大港口城市。

examples.en: We took the high-speed rail to Kaohsiung on Friday.
examples.zh: 我們星期五搭高鐵去高雄。

examples.en: My aunt runs a small shop in Kaohsiung.
examples.zh: 我阿姨在高雄開了一家小店。

examples.en: Korea is well known for its music and food.
examples.zh: 韓國以音樂和美食聞名。

examples.en: My friend will study in Korea next year.
examples.zh: 我朋友明年要去韓國念書。

examples.en: We watched a show about travel in Korea.
examples.zh: 我們看了一個介紹韓國旅遊的節目。

examples.en: She likes to cook Korean food on weekends.
examples.zh: 她週末喜歡煮韓式料理。

examples.en: I am taking a Korean class after school.
examples.zh: 我放學後在上韓語課。

examples.en: The Korean singer gave a concert in Taipei.
examples.zh: 那位韓國歌手在台北開了演唱會。

examples.en: My teacher can speak Korean and English.
examples.zh: 我的老師會說韓語和英語。

examples.en: Many Koreans enjoy eating spicy food.
examples.zh: 許多韓國人喜歡吃辣的食物。

examples.en: Korean is written with a special alphabet.
examples.zh: 韓語是用一套特殊的字母系統書寫的。

examples.en: We went to a KTV to celebrate her birthday.
examples.zh: 我們去KTV幫她慶祝生日。

examples.en: The KTV near the station is open until midnight.
examples.zh: 車站附近的KTV營業到午夜。

examples.en: My classmates and I sang many songs at the KTV.
examples.zh: 我和同學在KTV唱了很多首歌。

examples.en: Take the next left-hand turn to reach the bank.
examples.zh: 在下一個路口左轉就能到銀行。

examples.en: He lost his left-hand glove while walking home from school.
examples.zh: 他放學走路回家時，弄丟了左手的手套。

examples.en: The restroom is on the left-hand side of the hall.
examples.zh: 洗手間在走廊的左手邊。

examples.en: My grandmother speaks Mandarin and Taiwanese at home.
examples.zh: 我奶奶在家說國語和台語。

examples.en: She teaches Mandarin to foreign students at a local university.
examples.zh: 她在當地的一所大學教外國學生國語。

examples.en: We bought a bag of sweet mandarin oranges at the market.
examples.zh: 我們在市場買了一袋甜的橘子。

examples.en: Please give me a glass of water.
examples.zh: 請給我一杯水。

examples.en: My sister sent me a photo from Japan.
examples.zh: 我姊姊從日本寄了一張照片給我。

examples.en: Can you help me carry these books?
examples.zh: 你可以幫我搬這些書嗎？

examples.en: It might rain this afternoon, so take an umbrella.
examples.zh: 今天下午可能會下雨，所以帶把傘吧。

examples.en: She might be late because of the traffic.
examples.zh: 她可能會因為塞車而遲到。

examples.en: We might visit our grandparents next weekend.
examples.zh: 我們下週末也許會去探望祖父母。

examples.en: I prepared this lunch myself before leaving for school.
examples.zh: 出門上學前，我自己準備了這份午餐。

examples.en: I cut myself while peeling the apple.
examples.zh: 我削蘋果時不小心割到自己。

examples.en: Let me introduce myself to the class.
examples.zh: 讓我向全班自我介紹一下。

examples.en: We cleaned the classroom ourselves after the party.
examples.zh: 派對結束後，我們自己打掃了教室。

examples.en: We enjoyed ourselves at the night market.
examples.zh: 我們在夜市玩得很開心。

examples.en: We should be proud of ourselves for finishing the project.
examples.zh: 我們完成這個專案，應該為自己感到驕傲。

examples.en: The Philippines has more than seven thousand islands.
examples.zh: 菲律賓有超過七千座島嶼。

examples.en: My neighbor comes from the Philippines and teaches English nearby.
examples.zh: 我的鄰居來自菲律賓，在附近教英文。

examples.en: Many tourists enjoy the beaches in the Philippines.
examples.zh: 許多觀光客喜歡菲律賓的海灘。

examples.en: My phone is almost out of battery.
examples.zh: 我的手機快沒電了。

examples.en: Please answer the phone if it rings.
examples.zh: 電話響的話請接一下。

examples.en: He talked to his mother on the phone for an hour.
examples.zh: 他和媽媽講了一個小時的電話。

examples.en: I will phone you when I get home.
examples.zh: 我到家時會打電話給你。

examples.en: She phoned the hotel to change her booking.
examples.zh: 她打電話給飯店更改訂房。

examples.en: Please phone the office before you come.
examples.zh: 來之前請先打電話到辦公室。

examples.en: Our plane leaves for Tokyo at nine o'clock.
examples.zh: 我們的飛機九點飛往東京。

examples.en: The plane landed safely despite the strong wind.
examples.zh: 儘管風很強，飛機還是平安降落了。

examples.en: I looked out of the plane window and saw the clouds.
examples.zh: 我從飛機的窗戶往外看，看見了雲。

examples.en: The policewoman helped the lost child find his mother.
examples.zh: 那位女警幫迷路的孩子找到了媽媽。

examples.en: A policewoman stood at the corner directing traffic.
examples.zh: 一位女警站在轉角指揮交通。

examples.en: My aunt works as a policewoman in Taichung.
examples.zh: 我阿姨在台中擔任女警。

examples.en: The post office is on the right-hand side of the street.
examples.zh: 郵局在街道的右手邊。

examples.en: Please put the cup in the right-hand drawer.
examples.zh: 請把杯子放進右邊的抽屜。

examples.en: He lost his right-hand glove on the way to school.
examples.zh: 他上學途中弄丟了右手的手套。

examples.en: Russia is the largest country in the world.
examples.zh: 俄羅斯是世界上最大的國家。

examples.en: Winters in Russia can be extremely cold.
examples.zh: 俄羅斯的冬天可能會非常冷。

examples.en: My uncle once took a long train trip across Russia.
examples.zh: 我叔叔曾搭火車長途旅行橫越俄羅斯。

examples.en: The salesperson showed us several new laptops.
examples.zh: 銷售員向我們展示了幾台新的筆記型電腦。

examples.en: A friendly salesperson helped me choose a jacket.
examples.zh: 一位親切的店員幫我挑了一件外套。

examples.en: She works as a salesperson in a shoe store.
examples.zh: 她在一家鞋店當店員。

examples.en: Singapore is a small but very modern country.
examples.zh: 新加坡是個小而現代化的國家。

examples.en: We stayed in Singapore for three days.
examples.zh: 我們在新加坡待了三天。

examples.en: Her father often travels to Singapore for work.
examples.zh: 她的爸爸常因工作出差到新加坡。

examples.en: Somebody left a backpack in the classroom.
examples.zh: 有人把背包留在教室裡。

examples.en: I need somebody to help me with this math problem.
examples.zh: 我需要有人幫我解這道數學題。

examples.en: Is somebody waiting for you at the gate?
examples.zh: 有人在門口等你嗎？

examples.en: Taichung is known for its pleasant weather and bubble tea.
examples.zh: 台中以宜人的天氣和珍珠奶茶聞名。

examples.en: We visited a famous museum in Taichung last weekend.
examples.zh: 我們上週末參觀了台中一座有名的博物館。

examples.en: My cousin goes to university in Taichung.
examples.zh: 我表哥在台中念大學。

examples.en: Tainan is the oldest city in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 台南是台灣最古老的城市。

examples.en: People travel to Tainan to enjoy its local snacks.
examples.zh: 人們到台南品嚐當地的小吃。

examples.en: We walked around old temples in Tainan.
examples.zh: 我們在台南的古老廟宇間散步。

examples.en: I love Taiwanese street food, especially fried chicken.
examples.zh: 我愛台灣的街頭小吃，尤其是炸雞。

examples.en: The Taiwanese team played well in the final game.
examples.zh: 台灣隊在決賽中表現得很好。

examples.en: She is learning to cook Taiwanese dishes.
examples.zh: 她正在學做台灣菜。

examples.en: Many Taiwanese enjoy hot pot in winter.
examples.zh: 許多台灣人在冬天喜歡吃火鍋。

examples.en: My grandfather speaks Taiwanese with his friends.
examples.zh: 我爺爺和朋友說台語。

examples.en: A Taiwanese won the prize at the science fair.
examples.zh: 一位台灣人在科展中得了獎。

examples.en: We had a big family dinner on Thanksgiving.
examples.zh: 感恩節那天，我們全家一起吃了豐盛的晚餐。

examples.en: Thanksgiving is celebrated in November in the United States.
examples.zh: 美國在十一月慶祝感恩節。

examples.en: Our teacher told us the story of Thanksgiving in class.
examples.zh: 老師在課堂上跟我們說了感恩節的故事。

examples.en: I will call them after dinner to discuss our travel plans.
examples.zh: 晚餐後我會打電話給他們，討論我們的旅行計畫。

examples.en: The teacher gave them some homework to finish before Friday.
examples.zh: 老師給了他們一些要在星期五之前完成的功課。

examples.en: These apples look fresh, so let's buy them.
examples.zh: 這些蘋果看起來很新鮮，我們買下它們吧。

senses.zh: 他們自己；她們自己；它們自己

examples.en: The students cleaned the room themselves after the birthday party.
examples.zh: 生日派對後，學生們自己打掃了房間。

examples.en: The kids enjoyed themselves at the park.
examples.zh: 孩子們在公園玩得很開心。

examples.en: They should be proud of themselves for working so hard.
examples.zh: 他們這麼努力，應該為自己感到驕傲。

examples.en: The doctor suggested a new treatment for his back pain.
examples.zh: 醫生建議用新的療法治療他的背痛。

examples.en: All customers should receive the same friendly treatment.
examples.zh: 所有顧客都應該得到同樣親切的對待。

examples.en: This water needs special treatment before people can drink it.
examples.zh: 這種水需要經過特別處理，人們才能飲用。

examples.en: We watch TV together after dinner in the living room.
examples.zh: 我們晚餐後會一起在客廳看電視。

examples.en: Please turn off the TV and do your homework.
examples.zh: 請關掉電視去寫功課。

examples.en: They bought a new TV for the living room.
examples.zh: 他們為客廳買了一台新電視。

examples.en: We have English class every Monday morning.
examples.zh: 我們每個星期一早上都有英文課。

examples.en: We are going to the beach this weekend.
examples.zh: 我們這個週末要去海邊。

examples.en: Do we need to bring our own lunch?
examples.zh: 我們需要自己帶午餐嗎？

examples.en: She said she would call me after school.
examples.zh: 她說她放學後會打電話給我。

examples.en: Would you like some tea or coffee?
examples.zh: 你想喝點茶還是咖啡？

examples.en: When I was young, I would visit my grandparents every summer.
examples.zh: 我小時候，每年夏天都會去探望祖父母。

examples.en: Yeah, I think that is a great idea.
examples.zh: 是啊，我覺得那是個很棒的主意。

examples.en: Yeah, I finished my homework an hour ago.
examples.zh: 對，我一小時前就寫完功課了。

examples.en: "Are you coming to the party?" "Yeah, of course."
examples.zh: 「你會來參加派對嗎？」「會啊，當然。」
